# mao_death
country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_CHI.1
	title = COLDWAR_CHI.1.t
	desc = COLDWAR_CHI.1.d
	picture = GFX_CHI_generic

	trigger = {
		original_tag = CHI
		NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_mao_dead }
	}

	is_triggered_only = yes

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_CHI.1.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_CHI.1.a"
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_mao_dead
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_red_sun }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_red_sun
				add_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_mao_shadow
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { emerging_communist_state_are_in_power = yes }
			hidden_effect = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_mao_dead } } retire_country_leader = yes create_country_leader = { name = "COLDWAR_CHI_leader_mao_zedong" picture = "GFX_COLDWAR_CHI_leader_mao_zedong" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = communist_state } }
				else = { retire_country_leader = yes create_country_leader = { name = "COLDWAR_CHI_leader_hua_guofeng" picture = "GFX_COLDWAR_CHI_leader_hua_guofeng" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = communist_state } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# vote_member
country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_CHI.8
	title = COLDWAR_CHI.8.t
	desc = COLDWAR_CHI.8.d
	picture = GFX_CHI_china_unite

	is_triggered_only = yes

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_CHI.8.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_CHI.8.a"
		add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_yes = 1 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 3
			modifier = { factor = 3 check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
			modifier = { factor = 4 check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
			modifier = { factor = 2 check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0.3 check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
			modifier = { factor = 3 is_in_array = { recognised_countries = CHI } }
			modifier = { factor = 0.3 is_in_array = { recognised_countries = TAI } NOT = { is_in_array = { recognised_countries = CHI } } }
			modifier = { factor = 2 CHI = { is_in_array = { array = COLDWAR_CHI_lobbied value = PREV } } }
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_cosponsor }
			modifier = { factor = 1.1 check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_round > 0 } }
			modifier = { factor = 1.1 check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_round > 1 } }
			modifier = { factor = 1.1 check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_round > 2 } }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_CHI.8.b
		add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_no = 1 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 2
			modifier = { factor = 4 check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
			modifier = { factor = 3 is_in_array = { recognised_countries = TAI } }
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_opinion = { target = USA value > 50 } }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_CHI.8.c
		add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_abstain = 1 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
}

# vote_count
country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_CHI.9
	title = COLDWAR_CHI.9.t
	desc = COLDWAR_CHI.9.d
	picture = GFX_CHI_china_unite

	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_CHI.9"
		hidden_effect = { set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_no2 = global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_no } multiply_variable = { global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_no2 = 2 } }
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_CHI.9.a
		trigger = {
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_yes > global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_no }
			OR = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_important_question } check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_yes > global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_no2 } }
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_CHI_vote_count_tt
		clear_array = COLDWAR_CHI_lobbied
		COLDWAR_CHI_take_china_seat = yes
		add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_round = 1 }
		clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_vote_running
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_CHI.9.b
		trigger = {
			NOT = { AND = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_yes > global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_no } OR = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_important_question } check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_yes > global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_no2 } } } }
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_CHI_vote_count_tt
		clear_array = COLDWAR_CHI_lobbied
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_vote_lost
		add_to_variable = { global.COLDWAR_CHI_vote_round = 1 }
		clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_vote_running
		if = { limit = { country_exists = TAI } TAI = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHI.14 days = 1 } } }
	}
}

			limit = { mdcw_cw_can_join_beijing = yes }

			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_new_alignment = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_free = 1 }
			mdcw_cw_change_alignment = yes
			set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_free = 0 }
			hidden_effect = { mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes mdcw_cw_rebuild_blocs = yes mdcw_cw_refresh_all_bloc_effects = yes }
			FROM = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHI.23 days = 1 } }
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 2
			modifier = { factor = 0.2 check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_opinion = { target = FROM value > 50 } }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_CHI.24.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 3
		}
	}
}

	}

# offer_tazara_TNZ
country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_CHI.59
	title = COLDWAR_CHI.59.t
	desc = COLDWAR_CHI.59.d
	picture = GFX_EAF_event_signing

	is_triggered_only = yes

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_CHI.59.a
		trigger = {
			FROM = { exists = yes }
			NOT = { has_war_with = FROM }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_CHI.59.a"
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_pair_tazara_TNZ
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_tazara_partner } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHI_tazara_partner }
		set_temp_variable = { skip_payment = 1 }
		capital_scope = { one_state_infrastructure = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { skip_payment = 0 }
		FROM = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHI.57 days = 1 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 3
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_opinion = { target = FROM value > 40 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0.3 has_opinion = { target = FROM value < -20 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0.5 check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_CHI.59.b
		FROM = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHI.58 days = 1 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
			modifier = { factor = 3 check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_CHI.142
	title = COLDWAR_CHI.142.t
	desc = COLDWAR_CHI.142.d
	picture = GFX_CHI_event_china_russian_flag

	is_triggered_only = yes

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_CHI.142.a
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_CHI.142.a"
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_pair_three_obstacles_SOV
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_normalisation_china } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHI_normalisation_china }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_northern_vigilance } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHI_northern_vigilance }
		else_if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_prepare_for_war } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_CHI_prepare_for_war }
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_order_number_one }
			swap_ideas = {
				remove_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_order_number_one
				add_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_northern_vigilance
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CHI_reconcile_pairs = yes
	}
}

		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_CHI.150.a"
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHI_pair_enemy_of_enemy_USA
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_CHI_strategic_triangle_partner } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_CHI_strategic_triangle_partner }
		FROM = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHI.148 days = 1 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 3
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_opinion = { target = FROM value > 40 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0.3 has_opinion = { target = FROM value < -20 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0.5 check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_CHI.150.b
		FROM = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHI.149 days = 1 } }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
			modifier = { factor = 3 check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
		}
	}
}
